text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 16.0 to 16.8 s, closer creek shot. The white car is sunk to its roofline, empty seat backs visible through the glass, and it drifts slightly left while a pale wake curve and small tan floating pieces trail to its right. Along the far bank a pale tan band of water runs straight and horizontal across the entire frame width, bounded by straight horizontal lines above and below. Caption box sits on the water below the car.
